checks.title: Session cookies set without HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Session and authentication cookies are issued with HttpOnly, Secure and an explicit SameSite attribute.
checks.remediation: Set httpOnly:true, secure:true and sameSite:'lax' or 'strict' on session cookies (SESSION_COOKIE_* in Flask/Django); never write session cookies from JavaScript.

checks.title: DOM XSS sinks fed with non-literal input
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Untrusted data reaches the DOM only through text-safe APIs (textContent) or after sanitisation with a vetted library.
checks.remediation: Use textContent/framework interpolation, or pass HTML through DOMPurify.sanitize() before innerHTML, dangerouslySetInnerHTML or v-html.

checks.title: Debug mode enabled in production code or configuration
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Production builds run with debug/development mode disabled so stack traces and interactive consoles are never exposed.
checks.remediation: Set DEBUG=False / NODE_ENV=production in deployed configuration and drive any debug flag from environment settings that default to off.

checks.title: Permissive CORS with wildcard or reflected origin and credentials
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Credentialed cross-origin requests are allowed only for an explicit allowlist of trusted origins.
checks.remediation: Replace wildcard/reflected origins with a fixed allowlist, or disable credentials; never echo the Origin header without validating it.

checks.title: Command and code injection sinks built from dynamic strings
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Commands are executed with argument vectors (execFile, subprocess list form) and no input is passed to eval or Function.
checks.remediation: Use execFile/spawn or subprocess.run([...]) without a shell, validate arguments against an allowlist and remove eval/new Function.

checks.title: SQL statements built by string concatenation or interpolation
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Database queries use parameterised statements or an ORM; user input is never concatenated into SQL text.
checks.remediation: Switch to placeholders/prepared statements (cursor.execute(sql, params), $1 bindings) and allowlist any dynamic identifiers.

checks.title: TLS certificate verification disabled
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Outbound TLS connections validate certificate chains and hostnames.
checks.remediation: Remove verify=False / rejectUnauthorized:false / NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0; install the proper CA bundle for private CAs instead.

checks.title: Weak password hashing or insecure randomness for tokens
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Passwords are stored with a slow adaptive KDF (bcrypt, scrypt, Argon2) and tokens come from a CSPRNG.
checks.remediation: Hash passwords with bcrypt/Argon2id and generate tokens with secrets.token_urlsafe or crypto.randomBytes instead of Math.random/random.

checks.title: Open redirect driven by request parameter
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Redirect targets come from a server-side allowlist or are validated as same-site relative paths.
checks.remediation: Map user input to known destinations or validate with url_has_allowed_host_and_scheme / a strict relative-path check before redirecting.

checks.title: CSRF protection disabled or exempted
checks.expected_secure_behavior: State-changing endpoints enforce anti-CSRF tokens or equivalent same-site protections.
checks.remediation: Re-enable the framework CSRF middleware and remove blanket exemptions; secure webhook endpoints with signature verification instead.

checks.title: Session is invalidated server-side after logout
checks.expected_secure_behavior: After logout the old session token is rejected by the server and cannot be replayed.
checks.remediation: Destroy the server-side session (or revoke the token) on logout and verify replay of the old token returns 401.

checks.title: File upload validation (type, size, storage location)
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Uploads are validated for content type, size and name, stored outside the web root, and never executed.
checks.remediation: Enforce allowlisted types by content sniffing, size limits, randomised storage names and non-executable storage.

checks.title: Login rate limiting and account lockout
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Repeated failed logins are throttled or locked out and cannot be brute-forced.
checks.remediation: Add per-account and per-IP throttling with progressive delays, lockout or CAPTCHA and alerting on credential stuffing.
